Class TestTty

Namespace
Tuinet.Testing
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

An in-memory Tuinet.ITty for tests: script input with Tuinet.Testing.TestTty.Enqueue(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte}), resize with Tuinet.Testing.TestTty.Resize(System.Int32,System.Int32), and inspect what the terminal wrote. Counts writes and bytes so tests can pin the output cost of a frame. Suspends are recorded instead of stopping the process, and Tuinet.Testing.TestTty.Signal(Tuinet.TtySignals) simulates job-control signals from outside.

public sealed class TestTty : ITty, IDisposable

Suspend()

Restore the original modes, stop the process until it is continued (e.g. the shell's fg), then re-enter raw mode. Called only when Tuinet.ITty.CanSuspend; Tuinet.Terminal writes the leave and enter sequences around it.

public void Suspend()

TakeSignals()

Job-control signals from outside the app since the last call; called on every poll, so it must be cheap. Before reporting Tuinet.TtySignals.Continued, re-apply raw mode.

public TtySignals TakeSignals()
